description.value: Tluu Xaada Naay Society (Canoe People's House) is a Haida cultural organization based at a longhouse and cultural centre in Old Massett, offering immersive cultural tours, dance performances, and showcasing the work of master Haida carvers and artists. The society is led by renowned carver Christian M. White and is deeply engaged in preserving Haida visual arts, performance arts, language, and tradition. Touring cyclists visiting Northern Haida Gwaii can book cultural tours and encounter living examples of Haida canoe carving, totem pole work, and traditional dance.
